registry.note: A proposed model. Role requirements are editorial judgment, not labor-market data.

levels.label: Aware
levels.human: Can explain it and recognize it in use.
levels.agent: Has instructions; succeeds on simple cases.

levels.label: Assisted
levels.human: Does it with guidance or templates.
levels.agent: Succeeds with a tool or skill file; needs review.

levels.label: Independent
levels.human: Does it unaided on real work.
levels.agent: Passes its eval set; safe to run with spot checks.

levels.label: Lead
levels.human: Teaches it and sets the team's standard.
levels.agent: Passes adversarial evals; trusted inside its gates.

levels.label: Frontier
levels.human: Extends the state of the art.
levels.agent: Measurably best-in-class on public or held-out benchmarks.

branches.label: Math and ML foundations
branches.description: The quantitative ground: linear algebra, probability, optimization, and how learning systems generalize.

branches.label: Model literacy
branches.description: How frontier models behave: tokens, context limits, sampling, failure modes, and model selection.

branches.label: Prompt and context engineering
branches.description: Shaping what a model sees: instructions, examples, structured output, and context budgets.

branches.label: Retrieval and memory
branches.description: Getting the right knowledge into context: search, embeddings, RAG, and durable memory.

branches.label: Tools and integration
branches.description: Letting models act: function calling, MCP servers, APIs, browsers, and sandboxes.

branches.label: Agent architecture
branches.description: Loops, planning, multi-agent topologies, state, handoff, and long-running work.

branches.label: Evals and reliability
branches.description: Proving behavior: test sets, graders, regression gates, and production monitoring.

branches.label: Safety, security and governance
branches.description: Bounding authority: prompt injection, permissions, policy, risk tiers, and audit.

branches.label: Infrastructure and operations
branches.description: Serving, routing, cost, latency, observability, and incident response for AI systems.

branches.label: Data and training
branches.description: Datasets, labeling, fine-tuning, distillation, and preference optimization.

branches.label: Multimodal and creative generation
branches.description: Image, video, audio, and voice generation with consistency, rights, and taste.

branches.label: Product and strategy
branches.description: Choosing what to build, pricing AI work, change management, and portfolio decisions.

branches.label: Judgment and collaboration
branches.description: Calibration, verification, scoping, and working well across human and agent teams.

skills.label: Linear algebra for ML
skills.description: Vectors, matrices, projections, and decompositions as used in embeddings and attention.
skills.evidence: Derive attention scores by hand for a toy example.

skills.label: Probability and statistics
skills.description: Distributions, expectation, sampling error, and confidence intervals.
skills.evidence: Compute a confidence interval for an eval pass rate.

skills.label: Optimization and gradient descent
skills.description: Loss surfaces, gradient methods, learning rates, and regularization.
skills.evidence: Train a small model and explain each hyperparameter's effect.

skills.label: Neural network fundamentals
skills.description: Layers, backpropagation, and why depth helps.
skills.evidence: Implement and train a feedforward network on a real dataset.

skills.label: Transformer internals
skills.description: Attention, positional encoding, KV cache, and scaling behavior.
skills.evidence: Implement a minimal transformer and profile its KV cache.

skills.label: Interpretability methods
skills.description: Probing, attribution, and feature analysis of model internals.
skills.evidence: Publish an analysis that locates a behavior in model activations.

skills.label: Tokens and context limits
skills.description: Tokenization, context windows, and how length drives cost and quality.
skills.evidence: Estimate cost and context fit for a real workload within 10%.

skills.label: Sampling and determinism
skills.description: Temperature, top-p, seeds, and when outputs should vary.
skills.evidence: Show a task where sampling settings change the pass rate.

skills.label: Model failure modes
skills.description: Hallucination, sycophancy, refusal, truncation, and instruction drift.
skills.evidence: Reproduce three failure modes and a mitigation for each.

skills.label: Model selection and routing
skills.description: Matching task difficulty to model tier on quality, latency, and cost.
skills.evidence: Route a workload across tiers and report the quality/cost trade.

skills.label: Reasoning and extended thinking
skills.description: When to spend thinking budget, and how to read and bound it.
skills.evidence: Measure accuracy gain per thinking-token budget on a task.

skills.label: Frontier tracking
skills.description: Reading model cards, benchmarks, and releases without hype.
skills.evidence: Write a dated capability memo with sources for a new model.

skills.label: Instruction writing
skills.description: Clear, scoped, testable instructions with explicit done conditions.
skills.evidence: Rewrite a vague prompt so a grader can check every requirement.

skills.label: Examples and few-shot design
skills.description: Choosing examples that teach the boundary, not just the center.
skills.evidence: Show pass-rate change from example selection on a held-out set.

skills.label: Structured output
skills.description: Schemas, JSON modes, and validation-retry loops.
skills.evidence: Ship a schema-validated extractor with a measured failure rate.

skills.label: Context budgeting
skills.description: Deciding what enters context, in what order, and what gets compacted.
skills.evidence: Cut context size 50% with no eval regression.

skills.label: Prompt caching
skills.description: Ordering stable prefixes to cut latency and cost.
skills.evidence: Report cache hit rate and cost change on a real workload.

skills.label: Skill and instruction-pack authoring
skills.description: Packaging reusable know-how as skills with triggers and done conditions.
skills.evidence: Publish a skill that activates on its triggers and passes its own eval.

skills.label: Search and keyword retrieval
skills.description: BM25, filters, and when lexical search beats embeddings.
skills.evidence: Build a lexical baseline and report recall@k.

skills.label: Embeddings and vector search
skills.description: Embedding models, similarity, indexes, and their failure cases.
skills.evidence: Compare two embedding models on a labeled query set.

skills.label: Retrieval-augmented generation
skills.description: Chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and grounded citation.
skills.evidence: Ship a RAG system with measured groundedness and citation accuracy.

skills.label: Agent memory design
skills.description: Episodic, semantic, and procedural memory with write and decay rules.
skills.evidence: Show a memory policy that improves task success across sessions.

skills.label: Knowledge graphs
skills.description: Entity and relation modeling for multi-hop retrieval.
skills.evidence: Answer multi-hop questions a flat index fails on.

skills.label: Function calling
skills.description: Tool schemas, argument validation, and error returns a model can act on.
skills.evidence: Expose three tools and measure correct-call rate.

skills.label: Model Context Protocol
skills.description: Building and consuming MCP servers: tools, resources, prompts, auth.
skills.evidence: Ship an MCP server used by two different clients.

skills.label: API and SaaS integration
skills.description: Wrapping external APIs with auth, pagination, rate limits, and retries.
skills.evidence: Integrate an API with idempotent writes and backoff.

skills.label: Sandboxed code execution
skills.description: Running generated code in isolated environments with resource limits.
skills.evidence: Run untrusted code in a sandbox with enforced limits.

skills.label: Browser and computer use
skills.description: Operating GUIs and browsers through screenshots and actions.
skills.evidence: Complete a multi-page web task with a verified end state.

skills.label: Agent loop design
skills.description: Observe-think-act loops, stop conditions, and step budgets.
skills.evidence: Build a loop that halts correctly on success, failure, and budget.

skills.label: Planning and decomposition
skills.description: Breaking goals into checkable steps and replanning on new evidence.
skills.evidence: Show a plan that adapts after an injected failure.

skills.label: Multi-agent orchestration
skills.description: Topologies, delegation briefs, result synthesis, and conflict handling.
skills.evidence: Run a fan-out workflow that beats a single agent on a measured task.

skills.label: State and handoff
skills.description: Checkpoints, resumable work, and handoff notes another agent can act on.
skills.evidence: Resume a task in a fresh session from a handoff file alone.

skills.label: Long-horizon autonomy
skills.description: Multi-hour work with self-checks, budgets, and recovery.
skills.evidence: Complete a multi-hour task with a full receipt trail.

skills.label: Agent SDKs and frameworks
skills.description: Building on agent SDKs and graph frameworks without lock-in.
skills.evidence: Port one agent between two frameworks behind one interface.

skills.label: Eval set construction
skills.description: Representative, labeled cases including adversarial and edge cases.
skills.evidence: Build a versioned eval set with a documented sampling method.

skills.label: Model-graded evaluation
skills.description: Rubrics, judge calibration against humans, and judge bias.
skills.evidence: Report judge-human agreement on a labeled subset.

skills.label: Regression gates in CI
skills.description: Evals that can fail a build, with locked fixtures and thresholds.
skills.evidence: Show a CI run that fails on a seeded regression.

skills.label: Agent and trajectory evals
skills.description: Scoring tool use, trajectories, and end states, not just final text.
skills.evidence: Evaluate an agent on end-state checks across 50+ tasks.

skills.label: Production monitoring
skills.description: Tracing, drift detection, online evals, and feedback loops.
skills.evidence: Detect and attribute a real quality drop from traces.

skills.label: Prompt injection defense
skills.description: Treating fetched content as data and separating instructions from inputs.
skills.evidence: Pass an injection suite against a tool-using agent.

skills.label: Least-privilege tool authority
skills.description: Scoped credentials, human gates for irreversible actions, revocation.
skills.evidence: Show an action the model cannot talk past a gate.

skills.label: Data privacy and PII
skills.description: Redaction, retention, residency, and consent in AI pipelines.
skills.evidence: Run a pipeline with verified PII redaction before external calls.

skills.label: Red teaming
skills.description: Adversarial probing for jailbreaks, misuse, and unsafe actions.
skills.evidence: Publish a red-team report with reproducible findings.

skills.label: AI governance and risk tiering
skills.description: Use-case triage, risk tiers, policy, and regulatory mapping.
skills.evidence: Ship a risk-tiered AI policy adopted by a team.

skills.label: Audit trails and attestation
skills.description: Append-only logs and signed receipts for agent actions.
skills.evidence: Reconstruct an agent's actions from its audit log alone.

skills.label: Model serving and APIs
skills.description: Hosted APIs, gateways, rate limits, streaming, and fallbacks.
skills.evidence: Serve a feature with streaming and a provider fallback.

skills.label: Cost engineering
skills.description: Budgets, per-task unit cost, caching, and batch processing.
skills.evidence: Cut unit cost 30% with no eval regression.

skills.label: LLM observability
skills.description: Traces, spans, token accounting, and latency breakdowns.
skills.evidence: Trace a multi-step agent run end to end.

skills.label: Self-hosted inference
skills.description: GPU sizing, quantization, batching, and open-weight deployment.
skills.evidence: Serve an open-weight model at a target latency and cost.

skills.label: AI incident response
skills.description: Runbooks, rollback, and postmortems for model and agent failures.
skills.evidence: Run a postmortem with root cause and a regression test.

skills.label: Dataset curation
skills.description: Sourcing, cleaning, deduplication, and licensing of training data.
skills.evidence: Publish a dataset card with provenance and licenses.

skills.label: Labeling and annotation
skills.description: Guidelines, inter-rater agreement, and model-assisted labeling.
skills.evidence: Report inter-rater agreement on a labeled batch.

skills.label: Synthetic data generation
skills.description: Generating, filtering, and validating model-made training data.
skills.evidence: Show a synthetic set that improves a held-out metric.

skills.label: Fine-tuning and adapters
skills.description: Supervised fine-tuning, LoRA, and when not to fine-tune.
skills.evidence: Fine-tune a model that beats prompting on a measured task.

skills.label: Preference optimization
skills.description: RLHF, DPO, and reward modeling.
skills.evidence: Train with preference data and report win rate.

skills.label: Image generation
skills.description: Prompting image models for composition, style, and text rendering.
skills.evidence: Produce an on-brief image set that passes a review rubric.

skills.label: Video generation
skills.description: Text- and image-to-video, shot planning, and motion control.
skills.evidence: Deliver a multi-shot sequence with consistent subjects.

skills.label: Voice and audio generation
skills.description: Speech synthesis, voice design, and music generation.
skills.evidence: Ship a narrated asset with a consistent designed voice.

skills.label: Character and brand consistency
skills.description: Keeping identity, palette, and style stable across an asset set.
skills.evidence: Produce a 10-asset set with one character and brand system.

skills.label: Media rights and provenance
skills.description: Licensing, likeness, provider output terms, and provenance records.
skills.evidence: Attach a provenance record to every published asset.

skills.label: Creative direction
skills.description: Taste, briefs, and editorial judgment over generated media.
skills.evidence: Direct a campaign whose assets pass an independent review.

skills.label: AI use-case discovery
skills.description: Finding workflows where AI changes cost, speed, or quality.
skills.evidence: Rank ten use cases by value and feasibility with evidence.

skills.label: AI interaction design
skills.description: Designing for uncertainty, streaming, review, and recovery.
skills.evidence: Ship a flow where users correct AI output in one step.

skills.label: AI unit economics and pricing
skills.description: Pricing outcomes, margins under inference cost, and usage risk.
skills.evidence: Model margin per customer under three usage scenarios.

skills.label: AI adoption and change management
skills.description: Training, workflow redesign, and measuring adoption.
skills.evidence: Run a rollout with a measured adoption curve.

skills.label: AI strategy and portfolio
skills.description: Choosing bets, build vs buy, and kill criteria.
skills.evidence: Write a strategy with bets, kill criteria, and a review date.

skills.label: AI Center of Excellence design
skills.description: Operating models that scale AI capability across an organization.
skills.evidence: Stand up a CoE operating model with charter and metrics.

skills.label: Self-verification
skills.description: Checking claims against real files, outputs, and tests before asserting.
skills.evidence: Every claim in a handoff has a command or source behind it.

skills.label: Calibration and uncertainty
skills.description: Stating confidence that matches accuracy; abstaining when thin.
skills.evidence: Show stated confidence tracks measured accuracy.

skills.label: Scoping and success criteria
skills.description: Turning vague asks into bounded, checkable goals.
skills.evidence: Convert three vague requests into testable acceptance criteria.

skills.label: Delegation briefs
skills.description: Briefing a human or agent with goal, constraints, and done condition.
skills.evidence: A delegate completes a task from the brief with no follow-up.

skills.label: Human-agent teaming
skills.description: Dividing work between people and agents with clear approval gates.
skills.evidence: Run a team workflow with measured throughput and zero gate bypasses.

skills.label: Systems thinking
skills.description: Seeing feedback loops, second-order effects, and failure propagation.
skills.evidence: Predict and prevent a second-order failure in a design review.
